TITLE: Timesheets – Recent Entry Listed Six Hours Ahead and Refused When Moved
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10228 Verify Phase 9 — Drag and drop, board move, shift prompt (TESTING QA, read live 12 Oct 2026; the QA lead chose a separate ticket under the same story as SV-11229, 12 Oct) · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: REGRESSION. Production (12 Oct 2026, location set to America/Edmonton, three runs) lists a fresh entry at the real time (02:49 AM) and moves it to line 2 without any refusal. Likely the same six-hour fault as SV-11229, showing on another screen. Related, not a duplicate: SV-11087 (In Progress, Ahtasham) is about the technician staying on the old line after a move goes through. Picture 2x (S10043-19183, 12 Oct 2026).

h2. Description

A time entry should be listed at the time it was made, and it should be possible to move it to another line of the same work order.

For example,
* an entry made at about *3:03 AM* shop time is listed as *09:03 AM – 09:05 AM*, six hours ahead
* moving that entry to another line is refused with *Start date cannot be set in the future. Please try to resolve this.*, and the *Timesheets* section stops loading

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open a work order that has two lines, click the *Lines* tab and click the clock button on *line 1* to clock in a technician. Wait a minute, click the clock button again and click *Clock Out*.
# Click the three-dots button at the top right of the tabs and click *Timesheets*.
#* The new row's *Start Time* and *End Time* are six hours later than the shop's time.
# Point at the row and click the pencil icon at its right. In the *Edit Timesheet* window, open *Line*, pick *line 2* and click *Save*.
#* The red message *Start date cannot be set in the future.* shows, and the section reads *Something went wrong loading this section*.
# Click the *Lines* tab and reload the page.

*Actual Result:*
* The entry is listed six hours ahead of the shop's time.
* The move is refused as being in the future; line 2's *Labor* row still reads *Unassigned* and line 1 keeps the technician.

*Expected Result:*
* The entry is listed at the time it was made.
* The move saves with no error and line 2's *Labor* row shows the technician.
